_meta.notes: Phase-2 baseline. Hospital and police-post entries are point-of-reference, not exhaustive. Verify in-trip.

hunza-karimabad.general_safety_notes: Stable, well-trafficked. Standard mountain hazards (rockfall, weather).

skardu.general_safety_notes: Larger town. Deosai sub-trip requires acclimatization (4,114 m).

naran.general_safety_notes: Saif-ul-Malook (3,224 m) and Lulusar (3,410 m) are common day trips — watch altitude on kids.

fairy-meadows.general_safety_notes: High exposure. The jeep track from Raikot Bridge is famously narrow; only experienced drivers. No road-vehicle access to the meadows themselves; final segment is on foot.

murree.general_safety_notes: Most developed of the five. Standard urban-tourism risks; winter snow chaos common.

gilgit.general_safety_notes: Regional capital. Best medical access in GB. Acclimatization stop before higher destinations.

passu.general_safety_notes: Glacier-adjacent — guided treks only. KKH segment north of Hunza is landslide-prone in monsoon.

attabad.general_safety_notes: Lakeside. Wear life jackets for boat rides; lake-effect cold even in summer.

khaplu.general_safety_notes: Remote. Hushe Valley sub-trips can push above 4,000 m — proper acclimatization required.

swat-kalam.general_safety_notes: Generally stable. Mountain road from Mingora can be slow during peak season; flooding risk in the Swat River during monsoon.

shogran.general_safety_notes: Drive to Shogran from Kiwai is a steep jeep track — local 4x4 only. Siri Paye plateau adds another 600m gain.

neelum.general_safety_notes: Border zone. NOC required for foreign travellers. Sporadic security advisories near the LoC; check current bulletins.

deosai.general_safety_notes: Extreme altitude exposure (4,114 m). Acclimatization at Skardu (2,228 m) for at least one night before driving up. Tent-only; weather can turn quickly.

chitral.general_safety_notes: Stable city base. Sub-trips into the Kalash valleys are safe but remote — keep a buffer day for road conditions.

altitude_acclimatization_rules.buffer_day_definition: at least one overnight in the 2,200–3,000 m band before going higher
